item.title: Version 0.8.3
item.description:
What's New

  • The Wallpaper Automation sheet has an Explain This Page guide

Improvements

  • Pro: Sync subscribed wallpapers reads the subscription list Steam keeps for your account, so subscribe and unsubscribe changes made on Steam show up
  • Pro: scenes with many particles use less CPU

Bug Fixes

  • Pro: Workshop items whose file names contain ".." download and import again, and a failed import shows the real reason
  • Pro: if Loomscreen loses access to your Steam library, it says so instead of showing an empty Workshop, and it rescans the library at launch and right after you choose it again
  • Pro: a scene script that never finishes no longer freezes the app when Multithreaded rendering is turned off
  • Pro: linked scene timelines move together, and animations that start paused stay paused until a script plays them
  • Pro: origin animations that move only some axes play, and transform scripts can show, hide or fade other layers
  • Pro: god-ray effects no longer show a small copy of the scene through transparent areas
  • Pro: puppet characters whose intro animation plays once settle into their normal pose instead of keeping part of the intro

Not notarized — if macOS refuses to open the app, run xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Loomscreen Pro.app" once; updates Loomscreen Pro installs itself clear the flag. Full release notes · 完整发布说明
